meta.title: Searcy County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Searcy County's 2026 budget, taken from the county's budget detail report filed with the state. The amounts are the 'Original Budget' column, which is the budget the quorum court adopted for 2026. Some funds move money to other county funds (transfer lines, $6,162.15 in all); those dollars show up in both funds.
